title: Clearing the coefficients and certificates of a local submersive presentation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal and $R_{\mathfrak p}$ its localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $D$ be an $R_{\mathfrak p}$-algebra with the induced $R$-algebra structure. Let $n,m,c,t\ge0$, $c\le n+m$, and let $P$ be a submersive presentation of $D$ over $R_{\mathfrak p}$ on variables $x_1,\ldots,x_{n+m}$ and $c$ relations, whose Jacobian variables are the first $c$ [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra]. Let $g_j\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, $1\le j\le t$, vanish upon evaluation at the first $n$ generators of $P$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. There exist $f_1,\ldots,f_c\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_{n+m}]$, $s_0,\ldots,s_t\in R\setminus\mathfrak p$, and $h\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_{n+m}]$ such that every $f_j$ evaluates to zero at the generators of $P$, $s_0-h\det(\partial f_j/\partial x_i)_{i,j\le c}\in(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$, and $s_jg_j\in(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$ for $1\le j\le t$. The derivatives are those of [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative].

proof.text: Apply exists_cleared_submersive_presentation_core to obtain equations f, a scalar s0 outside p, an inverse-Jacobian ideal certificate h, vanishing of f, and the equality between the extended ideal (f) and the evaluation kernel.
Apply the proved exists_cleared_submersive_relations to that kernel equality and the supplied g and hg, obtaining a scalar sr_j outside p with C(sr_j) times the renamed g_j in (f).

Define s on Fin(t+1) by Fin.cases, using s0 at zero and sr_j at j.succ. Fin.cases proves all scalars lie outside p. Definitional reduction supplies the determinant and auxiliary-relation certificates, and retain the vanishing assertion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_cleared_submersive_presentation {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] {D : Type v} [CommRing D] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) D] [Algebra R D] [IsScalarTower R (Localization.AtPrime p) D] (n m c t : ℕ) (hc : c ≤ n + m) (P : SubmersivePresentation (Localization.AtPrime p) D (Fin (n + m)) (Fin c)) (hmap : P.map = Fin.castLE hc) (g : Fin t → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hg : ∀ j, aeval (fun i : Fin n ↦ P.val (Fin.castAdd m i)) (g j) = 0) : ∃ (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) R) (s : Fin (t + 1) → R) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + m)) R), (∀ j, s j ∉ p) ∧ (MvPolynomial.C (s 0) - h * Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin c ↦ pderiv (Fin.castLE hc i) (f j)) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin t, MvPolynomial.C (s j.succ) * rename (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_add_right n m)) (g j) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ∧ (∀ j, aeval P.val (f j) = 0)
